correctness.rationale: Exact K=aI+bJ normal matrix gives P3=1-z+z²-z³. Its direction-independent squared norm is 1+G/(1+r²+2rc); endpoints and 0<r<=1/2 are strictly negative. Any first crossing has interior G=Gc=0, whose exact resultant is 65536 r^16 (4r^6+4r^4+4r²+3)^2 H(r²). The substitution u=t/(1+t) yields a coefficient sequence with one sign change, ensuring H has exactly one root in (0,1). An exact rational witness at r=19/20,c=2/3 demonstrates the crossing is real; continuity forces its location to rho*. Direct exact matrix multiplication gives P3^T P3 = (1773279907/1728000000)I, proving exponential norm growth for all nonzero initializations. verify.py replays symbolic identities, not used as infinite enumeration.

value.rationale: The exact step-safety frontier addresses the natural cost-vs-stability question of using a fixed three-call approximation to a published implicit proximal saddle step. It quantifies a nontrivial gap between inner Picard contraction and outer stability, and exhibits strong-convex damping making a method diverge between stable pure-bilinear and scalar-gradient endpoints. A sharp entire-parameter classification and explicit geometric counterexample are structurally informative. No claim that the original safer logarithmic-budget implementation fails.
